_meta.note: Recaptured 2026-08-25. The V2 rewrite replaced the whole shape — grounding_message / reality_check / todays_actual_must_dos / anxiety_audit / objective_priorities / guilt_free_deferrals / energy_plan / overcommitment_warning are gone, and headline / do_first / do_next / can_probably_wait / need_one_fact / capacity_fit / just_one_thing took their place. The old sample was never recaptured, so check:golden failed on every section and backend/lib/completeness.js — which builds its expected shape from these files — logged tool_thin_result on every healthy call. A task appears in exactly one primary bucket; router.outputGuard is live. cp_ i18n split from ChaosPilot (chp_). optionalSections: a task appears in exactly ONE primary bucket, so which buckets are populated varies run to run — 2 of 3 clean runs put all three tasks in need_one_fact and left do_first empty. Presence of every key is still asserted; non-emptiness of the four buckets is not. (Whether "pay rent, 3 days late" belongs in need_one_fact rather than do_first is a real quality question, unresolved as of 2026-08-25.)
